title: Witness and Verdict
author: Bram Eriksen
blurb: Mirabel Winterbourne, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
